notes.title: Big Flute Master update!
notes.content:
After many requests, Flute Master finally supports fingering for baroque recorders!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334866/75a8c75a0f650686f750b8a5ab127e1038711e9f.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334866/455072ef814ea32680de5932cc8136d54ba4e5c1.png[/img]

Oh, and we also added support for our Music Store DLC packs, starting with [b]Epic Christmas[/b] and [b]Trick or Treat[/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334866/fe3f45c5fdbf78cb536bc82d6a684745dd3186a3.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25334866/ca9156f7f4fdd9c944310a1df7c3e0fe9f23fd55.png[/img]

Have fun!
